rationale: No E2E spec currently covers the ShortcutCheatsheet dialog or its capability gates — grep for 'cheatsheet|shortcut-cheatsheet|aiChatToggle|vue-shortcut-manager' under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests returns nothing, and the target spec file does not exist yet. The only existing test touching the gate is a Vitest unit test (web/src/lib/vue-shortcut-manager/__tests__/shortcutRegistry.spec.ts), not Playwright. The closest analog is status-pages-enterprise-gating.spec.js, which establishes the OSS skip-guard pattern (pm.statusPagesPage.detectBuildType) but tests a different feature (Status Pages dropdown gating), so it cannot be appended/extended. A brand-new spec under GeneralTests is required, and it must be registered in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json (GeneralTests run_files).
